searchText: I'm trying to verify that calling a contract selfdestructs it. I'm surprised that, after the contract selfdestructs, `EXTCODEHASH` returns the hash of the prior code. Of course, after the transaction completes, `EXTCODEHASH` returns 0. But that's no good for me because I'm trying to check the code after selfdestruct within the same transaction, so I can revert if it didn't. Self destruct is only applied at the end of the transaction. So, EXTCODESIZE wouldn't work then either. Is there no way for a caller to know their CALL ended in SELFDESTRUCT, or whether there is a pending destruction? Perhaps `EXTBALANCE` can be used. I have verified that the eth transfer of selfdestruct resolves immediately, so I can use EXTBALANCE for this purpose
